attribution.note: Derived statistics only. No dataset file is redistributed, and nothing in Seshat reads the dataset at run time.

lofi.authored_note: hiphop, dragged further behind the grid and looser, with fewer ghosts

trap.authored_note: dance timing with a half-time accent contour

units.density: hits per bar for this lane (p10/p50/p90 across source files)
units.ghost_probability: Live per-note probability applied to ghost hits
units.timing_mean: signed mean onset offset, as a fraction of a 16th note
units.timing_sd: onset offset standard deviation, same units
